DULUTH, Ga.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Boxlight Corporation (Nasdaq: BOXL) ("Boxlight" or the "Company"), a leading provider of interactive technology solutions, today announced that on November 18, 2026, the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") declared effective the Company's registration statement on Form S-1, satisfying a key condition to the funding of the second tranche of its Series D Preferred Stock financing and to the use of its equity line of credit of up to $15 million. The registration statement covers the resale by the selling stockholders named in the prospectus of up to 47,466,613 shares of Class A common stock, including shares issuable under the Company's Series D Preferred Stock and equity line of credit.

The second tranche would provide the Company with $2.0 million in gross proceeds and bring total gross proceeds from the Series D financing to $7.5 million. Funding of the second tranche remains subject to the satisfaction of the remaining closing conditions. The Company also expects to begin using its up to $15 million equity line of credit, subject to the terms and conditions of the equity purchase agreement. The Company intends to use the net proceeds to reduce debt under its senior credit facility with WhiteHawk Finance LLC and for working capital and general corporate purposes.

On November 18, 2026, the Company received notice from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") that, based on stockholders' equity of approximately $1.9 million reported for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, it does not meet the $2.5 million minimum stockholders' equity requirement of Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). Because the Company remains under a one-year panel monitor following a September 2, 2026 decision of the Nasdaq Hearings Panel (the "Panel"), Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Department (the "Staff") issued a delisting determination rather than a period to regain compliance. The Company intends to request a hearing before the Panel by the November 25, 2026 deadline, which will stay any suspension of trading, and the Company's Class A common stock will continue to trade on Nasdaq pending the Panel's decision. At the hearing, the Company plans to present its plan to regain compliance, supported by its Series D financing and equity line of credit. There can be no assurance that the Panel will grant the Company's request for continued listing.

"With our registration statement now effective, we have cleared a key step in the financing plan our stockholders recently approved," said Michael Pope, Executive Chairman. "The second tranche of our Series D financing, together with access to our equity line, would give us the capital to strengthen our balance sheet, support our customers and advance our plan to regain compliance with Nasdaq's stockholders' equity requirement as we continue to execute on our integrated education technology strategy."

The Company will not receive any proceeds from the resale of shares by the selling stockholders. The resale offering is being made only by means of a prospectus, a copy of which has been or will be filed with the SEC and will be available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.

This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any securities, nor shall there be any sale of these securities in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such state or jurisdiction.

About Boxlight Corporation

Boxlight Corporation (Nasdaq: BOXL) is a leading provider of education technology, campus communication and school safety solutions. Through its Clevertouch® interactive and non-interactive displays, CleverLive® digital signage, FrontRow™ classroom audio and the Boxlight Symphony™ campus communication platform, Boxlight connects instruction, communication and emergency alerting across classrooms, campuses and districts in a single integrated ecosystem. For more information, visit boxlight.com.

Key Terms

form s-1regulatory
A Form S-1 is the registration filing a company submits to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission when it plans to offer stock to the public, most commonly for an initial public offering. Think of it as the company’s full disclosure packet or blueprint: it contains audited financials, business description, management background, risk factors and details of the offering, giving investors the information needed to judge the company’s financial health and potential risks before buying shares.
equity line of creditfinancial
An equity line of credit is a loan that allows homeowners to borrow money against the value of their property, similar to having a flexible credit card secured by their home. It matters to investors because it provides a way for property owners to access cash for various needs, which can influence real estate markets and overall economic activity. This type of credit offers ongoing borrowing capacity, making it a valuable financial tool for those with significant property equity.
senior credit facilityfinancial
A senior credit facility is a large loan or revolving line of credit that a company borrows from banks or lenders and that has first claim on the company’s cash and assets if the business runs into financial trouble. Think of it as the “first in line” debt with stronger repayment priority and usually stricter rules, so investors watch it because its size, cost and covenants affect a company’s cash flow, risk profile and the value of equity and other creditors.
stockholders' equityfinancial
Stockholders' equity is the portion of a company's assets that belongs to its owners after all debts and obligations are paid; think of it as the value left for shareholders if the company sold everything and paid off what it owes. Investors watch it because it shows the company's net worth, indicates how much of growth is funded by owners versus debt, and helps assess financial health and the potential for future dividends or stock value increases — like the equity in a house after the mortgage is settled.

Caroline, 9, and Zoe, 12, will appear on limited-edition Well Market snack packaging, and each winner's nonprofit soccer organization will receive a $25,000 grant

WOONSOCKET, R.I., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CVS Pharmacy®, the retail division of CVS Health® (NYSE: CVS), and its Well Market® store brand consumables line today named Caroline, age 9, of Holmes Beach, Florida, and Zoe, age 12, of Los Angeles, California, the Grand Prize winners of the first CVS Home Team Heroes soccer contest. The nationwide contest recognizes young soccer players making a meaningful difference in their communities.

Each winner will receive a $25,000 grant for their nonprofit soccer organization, be featured on limited-edition packaging for select Well Market® snacks, CVS Pharmacy's store brand consumables line, and celebrate with a block party for their team. The limited-edition packaging will help bring the winners' stories to a broader audience when it arrives on select CVS Pharmacy shelves in 2027.

"Caroline and Zoe perfectly represent what we set out to celebrate through Home Team Heroes: young players who are showing up for others and making their communities stronger," said Mike Wier, Vice President of Store Brands at CVS Health. "Their stories demonstrate how the values built through soccer can extend far beyond the field. We're proud to recognize their impact, support the soccer organizations they selected to help more young people play, connect and thrive, and share their stories with a broader audience through Well Market."

Jordyn Bugg, Seattle Reign defender, surprised Caroline and Zoe with the news via video.

"Getting to tell Caroline and Zoe they're CVS Home Team Heroes was one of the best moments of my year. I started on a local field with coaches and teammates who believed in me, and it's really special to see these two show up for the players and communities around them," said Bugg. "I can't wait to walk into a CVS and see their faces on the shelf."

Echoing that sentiment, Croix Bethune, Kansas City Current midfielder, celebrated the winners and the impact they're making in their communities.

"Caroline and Zoe show what being a true team player is all about," said Bethune. "I'm honored to be part of sharing their stories and can't wait to see what the future holds for them."

Meet the Home Team Heroes

Caroline, 9, Holmes Beach, Florida
Caroline plays for The Center of Anna Maria Island's youth soccer program in Holmes Beach, Florida. After two hurricanes devastated the Center, Caroline and her older brother, Parker, started Print Wizards, selling 3D-printed toys to raise money for the organization. The siblings have raised more than $6,000 to help repair the fields and establish an all-girls soccer team.

For Caroline, soccer is a place to build camaraderie, confidence and leadership skills alongside her teammates. The Center of Anna Maria Island will use its $25,000 grant to continue rebuilding, support local families affected by the hurricanes and expand youth sports programming so more children can play.  

"As Caroline's parents, we're so proud to see her enthusiasm for her all-girls flag football and soccer team and her business, Print Wizards, recognized through CVS Home Team Heroes," said Brooke and Mike Svoboda. "At nine years old, she's discovering how her ideas can bring people together, and this support means so much to her and our family. It encourages her to keep dreaming big and making a difference in her community."

Zoe, 12, Los Angeles, California
Zoe plays for Tudela Fútbol Club Los Angeles in Los Angeles, California. Born with progressive hearing loss, she serves as a role model for children who are deaf or hard of hearing, regularly meets with newly diagnosed infants and their families, and speaks on student panels to share her experience. Zoe hopes to inspire other deaf soccer players by one day playing for the U.S. Women's Deaf National Team.

Tudela Fútbol Club Los Angeles will use its $25,000 grant to help make soccer more accessible by bridging gender and opportunity gaps and challenging the typical pay-to-play model.

"Discovering the U.S. Women's Deaf National Team gave Zoe something she had been missing: the chance to see herself reflected in the athletes she admired. Through USA Deaf Soccer, she found the confidence to embrace who she is, and when she arrived at her first Tudela FC tryout, someone greeted her in sign language — a simple gesture that showed her she belonged," said Angie Winslow, Zoe's mother. "We're incredibly proud to see Zoe now extending that same spirit of inclusion to younger athletes, and grateful that CVS is celebrating the power of a game that truly belongs to everyone."

What's next for Home Team Heroes
The celebration of this year's Home Team Heroes will continue into 2027. Two Runners-Up will be announced in early 2027, and CVS Pharmacy will visit the Grand Prize winners' hometowns to produce a video series highlighting their stories. The first episode is expected to debut in January. Limited-edition Well Market snacks featuring the winners are anticipated to arrive on CVS Pharmacy shelves in select markets in spring 2027, while supplies last.

Supporting youth soccer in communities
Home Team Heroes builds on CVS Health's broader, multi-year commitment to expanding access to play and supporting healthier communities through soccer. Through community field projects and programs that recognize young athletes making a difference, CVS Health is helping create more opportunities for young people to play.

CVS Health has supported community field projects in collaboration with the Alex Morgan Foundation in Diamond Bar, California, and Secaucus, New Jersey; as well as projects in Vancouver, Washington; Kansas City, Missouri; and Garfield Park in Washington, D.C.

Learn more about our Home Team Heroes winners and their stories at https://www.cvs.com/content/soccer/home-team-heroes. To learn more about how CVS Health is supporting its communities through soccer, visit cvs.com/content/soccer.

About CVS Health
CVS Health is a leading health solutions company simplifying health care one person, one family and one community at a time. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had approximately 9,000 retail pharmacy locations, more than 1,000 walk-in and primary care medical clinics and a leading pharmacy benefits manager with approximately 87 million plan members. The Company also serves an estimated 37 million people through a broad range of health insurance products and related services. The Company's integrated model uses personalized, technology driven services to connect people to simply better health, increasing access to quality care, delivering better outcomes, and lowering overall costs.

Black Friday offer and holiday promo codes aimed at the half of U.S. shoppers planning to give an experience this season

FORT WORTH, Texas, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corporation ("SEGG Media" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: SEGG) today announced that TicketStub.com will relaunch on a new platform on November 25, at the start of the holiday shopping season. TicketStub.com will open with a Black Friday offer, with details to be announced closer to launch, and will release promo codes for discounted tickets throughout the holidays.

Half of U.S. holiday shoppers plan to give an experience this year, up from 39% in 2024, and 19% plan to give tickets to an event, according to Deloitte's 2026 Holiday Retail Survey. The same survey found that 47% of shoppers would rather give one meaningful, higher-cost gift than several smaller ones. On the receiving side, concert tickets ranked second only to a full trip among the experiences Americans most wanted as a holiday gift, cited by 51% of respondents in a 2025 Talker Research survey of 5,000 adults commissioned by Chime.

Demand for live events is running at record levels. Live Nation Entertainment reported selling 170 million concert tickets through October 2026, up 13% year over year and already ahead of its total for all of 2025.

TicketStub.com gives users access to thousands of events around the world and earns revenue through service fees. The Company plans to add advertising and promoted listings as the platform develops. The relaunch follows the worldwide relaunch of Lottery.com on November 18 and is supported by the strategic financing commitments SEGG Media announced on November 12.

"Veloce's channels draw more than 500 million views a month from fans who follow racing, gaming and live sport. That's an audience that goes to live events, and putting TicketStub.com in front of them is our first priority," said Gregory Potts, Chief Operating Officer of SEGG Media. "We also plan to add an ongoing sweepstakes where users can win free tickets, concert experiences and other live event prizes. Along with the Black Friday offer and holiday promo codes, it gives fans a reason to keep coming back to TicketStub.com."

About SEGG Media Corporation

SEGG Media (Nasdaq: SEGG, LTRYW) is a global sports, entertainment, and gaming group operating a portfolio of digital assets including Sports.com, Concerts.com, TicketStub.com, Lottery.com, and Veloce Media Group. Regina, Saskatchewan--(Newsfile Corp. - November 20, 2026) - Above Food Ingredients Inc. (OTC: ABVEF) ("Above" or the "Company") announces today that its Business Combination Agreement with Palm Global Technologies Limited, UK ("Palm Global") dated May 16, 2025 (the "BCA"), and the related letter agreement dated December 31, 2025, have been discontinued. The proposed reverse merger between the Company and Palm Global will not proceed.

The BCA is not moving forward because Palm Global was unable to complete the due diligence required. Despite repeated requests, the Company did not receive evidence of those transfers, and without that verification the transaction could not proceed. No termination fee is payable by the Company.

Above Food continues to maintain the good relationship with all preferred partners like Promax Investments ("Promax") regarding potential opportunities to cooperate going forward.

The Company is also pursuing repayment of the amounts it advanced to Palm Global in connection with the transaction.

"We pursued this transaction in good faith, but we could not proceed without being able to complete the due diligence," said Lionel Kambeitz, Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Above Food. New York and Dubai, November 20, 2026 – VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON), a global digital operator, today announced that the full recording, presentation materials and photo highlights of its 2026 Capital Markets Day are now available on demand at veoncmd.com.

Under the vision “VEON 2030: A Better Life for All,” the company’s management team presented the Group’s strategy and its 2030 financial framework. This framework builds towards the following targets:

  • Earnings and cash flow: earnings per share and free cash flow growing faster than revenue
  • Shareholder returns: at least USD 200 million annually, through share buybacks and cancellation
  • Balance sheet discipline: net leverage at or below 1.5x, excluding leases

VEON also aspires to increase its mix of digital services to approximately 50% of Group revenue by 2030, from 27.2% in the 3Q26, by combining organic growth with selective acquisitions. The Group’s 2030 growth target above is on an organic basis.

Mercury Insurance explains what drivers should do before starting a flooded vehicle and how comprehensive auto coverage may help.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mercury Insurance (NYSE/NYSE TX: MCY) urges drivers whose cars have flooded to leave the engine off, even if the seats feel dry and the dashboard lights come on. Water can reach wiring beneath the carpet or enter the engine, and starting the car can make the damage worse. A qualified technician should inspect the vehicle before anyone attempts to drive it.

"It's a natural reaction to reach for the keys. You need to get to work, the water is gone and you want to know if the car still runs," said Michael Curcio, vice president of claims at Mercury Insurance. "Before starting your vehicle, take a moment to safely assess both your surroundings and the vehicle itself. If the vehicle was exposed to floodwater, starting it could be unsafe and may cause additional damage. Look for signs of water intrusion, such as mud, debris, or visible waterlines, and contact your insurer to report what you find. If possible, take photos showing how high the water reached. Even a simple photo of the waterline on the door can help your claims representative understand the situation and guide you through the next steps."

El Niño is currently helping to support an active pattern of atmospheric rivers across the West, including California. Atmospheric rivers can cause repeated rounds of heavy rain and widespread flooding. (https://www.noaa.gov/stories/what-are-atmospheric-rivers)

"If your garage, street or parking area has flooded before, choose another place to park before the storm arrives. Keep an eye on your local forecast and treat a flood watch or flood warning as a signal to move your car to higher ground" said Stephen Bennett, head of climate and catastrophe science at Mercury Insurance.

What to do if your car floods

  • Leave the vehicle off. If water entered the cabin or you suspect it reached the engine, skip the test drive, even a short one to the repair shop. Ask your insurer about towing and inspection. Electrical connections can corrode after the interior dries, so a problem may take time to appear.
     
  • Document what you can see safely. Wait until the water recedes and the area is safe to approach. Before cleaning up, photograph the vehicle, any visible waterline and the surrounding area. Note where the car was parked and approximately when the flooding occurred. Keep receipts for towing or storage.
     
  • Tell the tow operator if the vehicle is electric or hybrid. A flood-damaged high-voltage battery can pose a shock or fire risk. Leave the vehicle off, avoid plugging it in and contact the dealer for guidance. If you see smoke, sparks or flames, move away and call 911. Tell the dispatcher an electric or hybrid vehicle is involved.

Does auto insurance cover flood damage?

Comprehensive auto coverage generally helps pay for flood damage to the insured vehicle, subject to the policy's deductible and terms. Drivers can check the declarations page of their auto policy to see whether they carry comprehensive coverage on the affected car and which deductible applies. Liability-only coverage does not pay for flood damage to the driver's own vehicle.

Insurance coverage is subject to the terms, conditions, exclusions, limits and deductibles of the applicable policy. Roadside assistance and other optional coverages may not be included in every policy. This information is provided for general educational purposes and does not modify or expand coverage under any insurance policy.

Key Terms

scope 1technical
Scope 1 are the greenhouse gas emissions a company produces directly from sources it owns or controls, like fuel burned in company vehicles, boilers, or on-site factories. Think of it as the smoke coming out of a business’s own chimney versus electricity it buys from the grid. Investors watch Scope 1 because these direct emissions can create regulatory costs, operational changes, and reputational risks that affect profitability and long-term value.
scope 2technical
Scope 2 covers the greenhouse gas emissions produced indirectly when a business uses energy it buys from others—most commonly electricity, but also steam, heating or cooling. Think of it like the pollution linked to your household’s electricity bill: you didn’t burn the fuel yourself, but your consumption still causes emissions. Investors watch Scope 2 because it affects a company’s climate footprint, energy costs, regulatory exposure and reputation, all of which can influence long‑term financial performance.
scope 3technical
Scope 3 describes all greenhouse gas emissions that occur upstream and downstream of a company’s direct operations—things like emissions from suppliers, transportation, product use, and disposal. Think of it as the hidden carbon footprint tied to everything a business buys, sells, or enables; it matters to investors because these indirect emissions can drive regulatory costs, supply-chain disruption, consumer preference shifts, and long-term valuation risk that aren’t visible on a company’s factory floor or utility bill.
limited assuranceregulatory
An engagement where an independent auditor or reviewer provides moderate confidence that financial or non-financial information is free from material misstatement, but stops short of a full audit. Think of it as a focused check or review that uncovers obvious errors but does not involve the deep testing of a full audit. It matters to investors because it signals a lower level of independent verification of reported numbers, helping them judge how much trust to place in the disclosed information.

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 20, 2026) - Metaguest.AI Incorporated (CSE: METG) ("Metaguest" or the "Company"), an AI technology company transforming the hospitality sector through intelligent guest engagement, announces its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with the results of its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders held on November 19, 2026.

Metaguest reported EBITDA of $197,733 for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 99.2% from $99,273 in the second quarter, marking its second consecutive quarter of positive EBITDA. Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter was $190,179. EBITDA for the corresponding quarter of 2025 was $(328,288).

The Company also recorded net income of $66,734 for the third quarter, compared with a net loss of $494,449 in Q3 2025.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, EBITDA improved to $237,282, compared with $(858,506) in 2025. Adjusted EBITDA was $220,613. The Company's nine-month net loss decreased by approximately 86%, from $1,305,425 to $180,748.

These improvements reflect the Company's ongoing cost-management initiatives, organizational changes and strengthened financial oversight.

Management Commentary

Colin Keddy, President and Director of Metaguest, commented:

"Our third-quarter results reflect the progress we have made in strengthening the Company's financial and operating structure. Achieving a second consecutive quarter of positive EBITDA, with a substantial increase over the preceding quarter, demonstrates the impact of our efforts to streamline operations and manage costs while maintaining our established hotel distribution network.

"With a more disciplined operating structure in place, we are now focused on advancing our technology, enhancing the digital guest experience and developing additional revenue opportunities across our hotel network.

"We recognize that these initiatives will require further investment and may affect profitability in future periods. Our objective is to balance those investments with responsible financial management as we work toward building a stronger and more scalable business."

As the Company increases investment in technology and development, operating expenditures may rise and could result in net losses in future periods. Management believes these investments are important to supporting the Company's longer-term growth and monetization strategy.

JOHANNESBURG, South Africa, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ProText Mobility, Inc. (OTC: TXTM) today presents a comprehensive strategic shareholder update from its Chairman and President, Dr. Ahmed Jamaloodeen, addressing the Company’s real-world asset foundation, proprietary biotechnology, agricultural production, digital tokenisation infrastructure, institutional banking relationships, international strategic initiatives, financial reporting programme and regulated-exchange roadmap.

The Chairman’s statement provides an integrated overview of the Company’s established capabilities, recent implementation milestones and strategic priorities for translating its asset base and commercial relationships into revenue, profitability and long-term shareholder value.

A MESSAGE FROM DR AHMED JAMALOODEEN, Chairman and President:

DEAR FELLOW SHAREHOLDERS, PROSPECTIVE INVESTORS AND MARKET PARTICIPANTS,

I believe it is important to provide shareholders with a comprehensive understanding of what has been assembled at ProText Mobility, Inc., how the various components connect and the economic significance of our broader corporate strategy.

Over the past several years, we have brought together substantial real-world assets, agricultural production capabilities, proprietary biotechnology, pharmaceutical-related inventory, digital tokenisation infrastructure, institutional financial relationships and international commercial opportunities.

We have also established important corporate reporting, investor-relations and information-technology infrastructure.

These are not disconnected initiatives.

They form an integrated business ecosystem designed to create, enhance, administer and monetise real-world economic assets.

Our strategy has always extended beyond one product, one technology, one token or one transaction.

And it begins with an important distinction.

WE ARE NOT STARTING FROM ZERO.

We have existing assets.

We have established technologies.

We have demonstrated agricultural multiplication.

We have pharmaceutical-related inventory.

We have deployed digital infrastructure.

We have institutional banking relationships.

We have agreed financial arrangements.

We have international commercial relationships developed over decades.

And we have an existing publicly traded company through which qualifying economic opportunities can be developed.

The next stage of our roadmap is focused on translating these components into measurable revenue, profitability and long-term shareholder value.

1. OUR EXISTING REAL-WORLD ASSET FOUNDATION

ProText Mobility’s previously published financial statements already reflect substantial real-world assets.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company reported approximately:

1.9 BILLION AGRICULTURAL SEEDS

With a recorded carrying value of approximately: US$605 MILLION.

Separately, in September 2025, True Leaf Holdings (TruLeaf) contributed:

125,959,995 MILLIGRAMS OF ACTIVE PHARMACEUTICAL INGREDIENTS.

The Company’s financial disclosures recorded these APIs at the contributor’s historical cost of approximately US$6.298 million under US GAAP.

The contribution also had an estimated fair market value of approximately US$10.71 million at the time.

These figures represent previously disclosed accounting and valuation measures, rather than cash balances or completed monetisation proceeds.

The significance of these assets extends beyond their reported financial values.

They provide an established economic foundation for our biotechnology, agricultural and digital financial infrastructure.

REAL ASSETS UNDERPIN THE BUSINESS.

2. AGRICULTURAL MULTIPLICATION — ADDITIONAL ASSETS THROUGH PRODUCTION

Our seed multiplication agreement was established in October 2023.

Through this arrangement, qualifying seed inventory has undergone planting, germination, harvesting, processing and subsequent return to the Company.

Multiple completed production cycles have been documented in our financial disclosures.

During the first quarter of 2026 alone, the Company recorded an increase of approximately 300 million seeds through its established multiplication programme.

This is an accomplished agricultural activity.

The economic principle is straightforward.

EXISTING BIOLOGICAL ASSETS CAN PRODUCE ADDITIONAL BIOLOGICAL ASSETS.

Our Chairman’s independent agricultural operations and related commercial arrangements provide access to longstanding farming experience, infrastructure and production capabilities.

These resources have been developed over generations.

The relevant assets, permits and contractual relationships are distinguished according to their legal ownership and the Company’s public disclosures.

The multiplication programme demonstrates the productive foundation supporting our asset-development strategy.

But increasing the quantity of assets is only one component.

An equally important component is increasing their commercial value.

3. KETTLE TECHNOLOGY AND NANOTECHNOLOGY — ENHANCING ECONOMIC VALUE

This is where our proprietary biotechnology connects directly with our real-world asset and financial infrastructure.

ProText Mobility’s Kettle technology and live-plant extraction capabilities are established components of our biotechnology platform.

The Company’s relationship with TruLeaf adds complementary nanotechnology and pharmaceutical-related expertise.

These capabilities create pathways for transforming qualifying biological materials into extracts, cannabinoid-related APIs and differentiated formulations.

Nanotechnology provides opportunities to enhance the bioavailability and delivery characteristics of suitable formulations.

The commercial importance of this combination is substantial.

OUR BUSINESS IS NOT LIMITED TO INCREASING THE NUMBER OF PHYSICAL ASSETS.

We also have technological capabilities relevant to increasing the economic value generated from qualifying biological materials.

A raw agricultural input, a refined extract and a specialised pharmaceutical-related formulation can possess substantially different commercial applications and values.

Where processing, quality verification, product performance and market demand support such differences, the resulting economic value can be independently assessed.

Our business therefore incorporates two complementary value-creation mechanisms.

ASSET MULTIPLICATION

Producing additional biological assets through established agricultural processes.

ASSET VALUE ENHANCEMENT

Applying Kettle extraction and complementary nanotechnology to develop commercially differentiated products.

This is a fundamental component of our broader strategy.

WE HAVE THE PHYSICAL ASSETS.

WE HAVE THE TECHNOLOGY.

WE HAVE THE PRODUCTION CAPABILITIES.

These components connect directly with our digital tokenisation infrastructure.

4. TRULEAF — A SEPARATE PHARMACEUTICAL-RELATED ASSET BASE

The TruLeaf API contribution introduced an additional category of physical assets into TXTM’s reported inventory.

It also strengthened the connection between our agricultural activities, biotechnology capabilities and pharmaceutical-related opportunities.

The existing API contribution provides an additional foundation for appropriate commercial applications involving biological materials, specialised extracts and formulated products.

Kettle technology and complementary nanotechnology provide established technological capabilities relevant to this value chain.

TXTM IS NOT SIMPLY A SEED-INVENTORY BUSINESS.

Its broader ecosystem encompasses agricultural production, biotechnology, cannabinoid-related APIs, digital infrastructure and financial applications.

The integration of these capabilities is central to the Company’s identity.

5. THE CONNECTION BETWEEN RWA VALUE AND TOKEN VALUE

One of the most important features of our strategy is the relationship between underlying physical economic value and digital asset representation.

Our existing agricultural multiplication programme has demonstrated the production of additional inventory.

Our biotechnology capabilities provide pathways for enhancing the commercial value of qualifying biological materials.

Our tokenisation infrastructure connects eligible underlying assets with digital financial applications.

This creates two potential mechanisms for increasing the asset value represented within an appropriately structured token programme.

FIRST: Additional independently verified underlying assets.

SECOND: Increased independently supportable value of qualifying underlying assets.

For example, additional verified seed inventory may support further authorised token issuance.

Separately, higher-value commercial outputs may support a revised asset valuation or an additional tokenisation structure, depending upon the legal rights represented.

Changes in underlying economic value can be reflected in the applicable token’s independently determined net asset value where its governing methodology permits.

Such changes do not automatically establish a higher market trading price.

THE VALUE ORIGINATES WITH THE UNDERLYING ECONOMIC ASSETS.

The tokenisation infrastructure provides the mechanism for their digital representation and financial administration.

This principle also extends to other eligible real-world asset classes, including verified environmental assets and carbon credits.

6. SVLT — DEPLOYED DIGITAL ASSET INFRASTRUCTURE

The Seed Vault Token programme is an established component of our ecosystem.

SVLT has been deployed using an ERC-3643 permissioned architecture incorporating identity, compliance and administrative functionality.

The Company’s agricultural seed-tokenisation initiative has already been publicly announced.

The infrastructure has been developed to support the digital representation of qualifying real-world assets.

Its importance lies in connecting tangible economic resources with appropriate verification, governance and institutional financial systems.

SVLT is not being presented as a speculative public token sale.

Its role within our strategy is the digital representation and administration of defined asset-related rights.

The broader tokenisation architecture can also support evaluation of additional qualifying asset classes.

TOKENISATION IS AN ENABLER OF ECONOMIC VALUE — NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR IT.

7. OUR DIGITAL DASHBOARD AND INFORMATION-TECHNOLOGY ECOSYSTEM

Our digital dashboard and broader information-technology infrastructure are established components of the business.

They provide the technological foundation for asset information, digital administration and the integration of appropriate financial applications.

The business model encompasses two complementary activities.

TXTM-RELATED ASSETS

Qualifying assets owned by the Company and developed through its commercial activities.

THIRD-PARTY ASSET SERVICES

Digital asset administration, tokenisation and related technology services for qualifying third-party asset owners.

This distinction is significant.

Traditional asset-management businesses may generate revenue by managing assets that belong to others.

Our model combines that potential service opportunity with an existing base of physical assets and productive capabilities.

The objective is to generate commercial value from both asset-related activities and financial infrastructure services.

The ownership of third-party assets remains separate from TXTM’s own balance sheet.

8. ABSA — ESTABLISHED INSTITUTIONAL CUSTODY AND AGREED FINANCIAL ARRANGEMENTS

In September 2026, the Company publicly announced that ABSA had confirmed the Chairman’s participation as its inaugural pilot client in the bank’s digital-asset custody onboarding programme.

The relevant onboarding, approvals, documentation and signatures are complete.

The Chairman’s profile is ready on the system.

ABSA has confirmed: “Your profile is ready on the system.”

The custody wallet is established and ready specifically to receive SVLT.

ABSA CUSTODY ONBOARDING IS COMPLETE.

THE PROFILE IS READY. THE SVLT WALLET IS READY.

The platform walkthrough is now being coordinated as part of operational execution, followed by the first SVLT test transfer.

This is a demonstration of the established system and its operation.

In addition, the Chairman confirms that institutional trading and monetisation arrangements have been agreed with ABSA.

THE AGREEMENT STAGE IS NOT BEING DESCRIBED AS AN ASPIRATION.

THE ARRANGEMENTS ARE AGREED. WE ARE EXECUTING NOW.

The focus is on implementing those arrangements, completing and verifying relevant digital asset transfers, and reporting commercial transactions and financial results as they occur.

Institutional custody is an established component of our broader asset-backed financial infrastructure.

THE FOUNDATION IS ESTABLISHED. THE INFRASTRUCTURE IS IN PLACE. EXECUTION CONTINUES.

8A. TXTM COMMON AND PREFERRED STOCK TOKENISATION — SMART CONTRACT COMPLETED

Separate from SVLT, our TXTM equity-tokenisation programme is moving forward with implementation.

The programme encompasses the Chairman’s personally held TXTM common and preferred stock.

Our technical implementation partner has confirmed completion of the smart contract for the TXTM token.

THE SMART CONTRACT IS COMPLETE.

The requested brokerage statements and supporting ownership documentation covering the Chairman’s personally held common and preferred stock have been submitted.

Receipt has been confirmed.

DOCUMENTATION SENT. RECEIPT CONFIRMED.

The next step is the deployment walkthrough for the TXTM token.

This programme concerns the digital representation and administration of existing equity-related interests.

It is distinct from SVLT and the tokenisation of agricultural or other physical assets.

The underlying common and preferred stock already exists.

Tokenisation of these existing interests does not itself issue additional TXTM common shares or convert the Chairman’s preferred stock into common shares.

The legal and economic rights represented by the tokens will be governed by the applicable transaction documentation, with the underlying ownership records and transfer requirements preserved.

This adds a separate equity-related component to our established digital infrastructure and broader capital-markets programme.

EXISTING COMMON AND PREFERRED STOCK.

SMART CONTRACT COMPLETED.

OWNERSHIP DOCUMENTATION RECEIVED.

DEPLOYMENT WALKTHROUGH NEXT.

9. BNY MELLON, OTHER BANKING INSTITUTIONS AND THE FAMILY OFFICE

Our institutional relationships extend beyond ABSA.

The Chairman maintains an existing direct account relationship with BNY Mellon.

This is a direct BNY relationship and is separate from the ABSA custody initiative.

The Chairman also confirms additional established relationships and agreed financial arrangements involving other banking institutions.

These relationships have been developed through longstanding commercial and institutional engagement.

The family office provides an established international network, financial relationships, credit resources and commercial experience.

These capabilities have developed over many years.

They are part of the broader institutional foundation supporting the Chairman’s international business activities.

Personal and family-office accounts, credit facilities and assets remain legally distinct from those of TXTM unless expressly committed to the Company under applicable agreements.

The significance is that the broader ecosystem is supported by existing financial relationships and commercial experience rather than depending entirely on newly introduced institutional contacts.

WE HAVE THE RELATIONSHIPS.

WE HAVE THE EXPERIENCE.

WE HAVE THE FINANCIAL CONNECTIVITY.

10. INSURANCE WRAPS, PERFORMANCE GUARANTEES AND INSTITUTIONAL MONETISATION

Insurance and contractual performance protections form another component of our financial strategy.

The Chairman confirms that valuation documentation, auditor support and insurance arrangements have been assembled.

The financial architecture incorporates insurance-wrap and performance-guarantee considerations relevant to specified contractual obligations.

These arrangements can support the management of defined financial and counterparty risks according to their governing terms.

Our broader financial strategy connects qualifying real-world assets, valuation, digital representation, institutional custody and collateral arrangements.

VANCOUVER, BC and GLIL YAM, Israel, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IM Cannabis Corp. (the "Company") (NASDAQ: IMCC) announced changes to its management and board of directors (the "Board"), including the appointment of Ronen Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer and Ohad Melnik as an independent director.

Management Changes

Effective November 19, 2026, the Board appointed Ronen Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, succeeding Oren Shuster, who resigned from that role.

Mr. Zalayet has more than 25 years of experience in financial leadership positions in private and public companies. He has served as Chief Financial Officer of Nexera Technologies Ltd. (formerly Jeffs' Brands Ltd.), a company listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq"), since October 2022. From July 2021 to December 2023, he served as Chief Executive Officer and a director of Shemen Oil and Gas Resources Ltd., a company listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. From July 2025 to June 2026, he served as Chief Financial Officer of Fort Technology Inc., a Canadian company listed on Nasdaq (formerly Impact Acquisition Corp.). From November 2019 to June 2021, Mr. Zalayet served as Chief Financial Officer of Colugo Systems Ltd., and from 2016 to 2020, he served as a consultant, a director and head of the Israeli office of Access Capital Markets Limited. Mr. Zalayet holds a B.A. in Economics and Accounting and an M.B.A. from Tel Aviv University and is a certified public accountant in Israel.

The Board thanks Mr. Shuster for his leadership of the Company since its founding and for his many contributions and welcomes Mr. Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer.

In addition, effective November 19, 2026, Shakked Shuster was appointed as Chief Executive Officer of Focus Medical Herbs Ltd., the Company's Israeli subsidiary through which it operates its medical cannabis business in Israel, succeeding Oren Shuster following his resignation from that role. 

Mr. Shakked Shuster has more than six years of experience in Israel's medical cannabis industry through his work at the Company, spanning product, international sourcing, brand partnerships and marketing. He joined the Company in July 2020 as Product Marketing Lead before taking on the role of Product Manager from 2021 to 2022. In that role, he set the Company's product and quality standards and spent an extended period working with the team at its southern cultivation facility. Beginning in mid-2021, he led the development of the Company's import program, working with Canadian craft producers to establish supply from Canada to Israel. As Head of Product & Marketing from May 2022 to September 2023, he oversaw the product portfolio and the full marketing team. His work focused on expanding the product offering and strengthening international partnerships, including negotiating brand-licensing agreements and launching and developing the brands in the Israeli market. In September 2023, he stepped back from full-time management and continued working with the Company as an independent consultant, supporting business development with Canadian suppliers and exploring opportunities to bring new brands and products into Israel. Since May 2026, he has worked full time in the Company's Israeli operations.

Before joining the Company, Mr. Shakked Shuster served as a product designer in Unit 81, the technology unit of the Special Operations Division of the Israel Defense Forces' Intelligence Directorate, from 2016 to 2019.

Board Changes

Effective November 19, 2026, Oren Shuster resigned as a director of the Company and will continue to serve as a director of the Company's Israeli subsidiaries.

Effective November 19, 2026, Ohad Melnik was appointed to the Board to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Einat Zakariya in September 2026. Mr. Melnik's appointment is subject to the approval of the Israel Medical Cannabis Agency (IMCA). The Board has determined that Mr. Melnik is an independent director under the Nasdaq listing rules.

Mr. Melnik served as a director of Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. from January 2019 to May 2024. He currently serves as an independent consultant on international online payments to the iFOREX Group and as a director of iFOR Fintech Ltd. an Israeli subsidiary of the iFOREX Group, and previously served as a director of the payment methods department and the finance compliance department of iFOREX International Group. He previously served as a director of Peninsula Group Ltd. from 2008 to 2015 and of Jerusalem Technology Investments Ltd. from 2012 to 2015. Mr. Melnik holds a B.A. in Business Administration and an M.B.A. (cum laude) from the College of Management, and is a graduate of the Executive M.S. in Finance program at Baruch College, City University of New York.

About IM Cannabis Corp.

IM Cannabis Corp. (NASDAQ: IMCC) is an international company operating a medical cannabis platform serving patients in Israel.

The Company's ecosystem operates in Israel through its subsidiaries, which import and distribute cannabis to medical patients, leveraging years of proprietary data and patient insights. The Company also operates medical cannabis retail pharmacies and online platforms in Israel that enable the safe delivery and quality control of IMCC's products throughout the value chain.

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Caliber (Nasdaq: CWD), a real estate-focused alternative asset manager, today published its inaugural investor FAQ at caliberco.com/investors/faq. The FAQ answers 67 questions about Caliber's business model, its two businesses, its plans and objectives, its balance sheet and its stock.

Caliber wrote the FAQ by putting itself in the position of a prospective shareholder and answering the questions it would want answered. Each answer is in plain English and cites the filing or release it comes from and the date of each figure. Most answers bring together what Caliber has already reported; some add new detail, including a breakdown of the real estate Caliber owns directly or has invested in. Caliber is furnishing the full FAQ to the Securities and Exchange Commission today on Form 8-K.

"We asked what we would want to know if we were a shareholder, and then answered it: how the business makes money, where it is headed and what stands in the way. More investors now research a company through a stock screener or an AI tool before they ever speak with management, and those answers should come from the company, in plain English and tied to our filings. We plan to update the FAQ every quarter when we report," said Chris Loeffler, CEO of Caliber.

Two businesses
Caliber is one public company with two businesses. Its real estate investment platform has sponsored, built and managed middle-market real estate since 2009 and produces substantially all of Caliber's revenue today. It is the foundation of the Company, and its objective is steady, consistent profitability. Its tokenization platform, built around Caliber Tokenization Services, brings tokenization to private real estate funds, starting with the funds Caliber manages, and is designed to be Caliber's growth engine. Caliber holds LINK, the token of the Chainlink network, in its corporate treasury as part of its tokenization strategy; today it is not a pure play LINK treasury company.

What the FAQ covers.

  • The business: what Caliber does, how it makes money, how performance allocations are earned, and the real estate Caliber owns directly or has invested in
  • Plans and objectives: the objective for each business, the 2026 guidance, the projects underway and how interest rates are affecting them
  • The tokenization platform: what tokenization changes for an investor and what it does not, Caliber Tokenization Services and CNAV, and the LINK Caliber holds in its treasury
  • The funds: how a private fund investment differs from owning CWD stock, how Caliber works with financial advisors, and where fund investors take account questions
  • The balance sheet and the stock: the going concern language and the plan for the corporate notes, the changes in auditor and CFO, the share count and the Nasdaq listing
  • How to read the reports: consolidated GAAP results versus Platform results, and what Managed Assets, Managed Capital and fair value assets under management each measure

How it is kept current
Caliber plans to update the FAQ each quarter with its earnings release and to furnish it to the Securities and Exchange Commission when it changes. Furnishing it on Form 8-K gives every investor the same information at the same time. Each question has its own link. Investors can send questions the FAQ does not answer to Investor Relations; questions Caliber hears more than once become candidates for the next update.

What it is not
The FAQ is company information about CaliberCos Inc. It is not sales material for any fund. It does not predict the price of the Company's stock.
